lines: Hum to hain pardes mein, desh mein nikla hoga chaand
couplets.en: Here I am far from home, where the moon must have risen.

lines: Apni raat ki chhat par kitna tanha hoga chaand
couplets.en: How lonely the moon must be on the rooftop of its night.

lines: Hum to hain pardes mein, desh mein nikla hoga chaand
couplets.en: Here I am far from home, where the moon must have risen.

lines: Jin aankhon mein kajal ban kar tairi kaali raat
couplets.en: In those eyes the dark night once floated like kohl.

lines: Un aankhon mein aansoo ka ek qatra hoga chaand
couplets.en: In those same eyes the moon must be a single tear.

lines: Hum to hain pardes mein, desh mein nikla hoga chaand
couplets.en: Here I am far from home, where the moon must have risen.

lines: Raat ne aisa pech lagaya, tooti haath se dor
couplets.en: The night made such a sudden turn that the kite string snapped in my hand.

lines: Aangan wale neem mein ja kar atka hoga chaand
couplets.en: The moon must have snagged in the neem tree in the courtyard.

lines: Hum to hain pardes mein, desh mein nikla hoga chaand
couplets.en: Here I am far from home, where the moon must have risen.

lines: Chaand bina har din yun beeta, jaise yug beete
couplets.en: Without the moon, each day felt like an age.

lines: Mere bina kis haal mein hoga, kaisa hoga chaand
couplets.en: How is the moon faring without me, I wonder?
